# Kiln

> Kiln is a compiled, garbage-collected language for web servers and sites. A program is a folder of `.kiln` files (folders are modules), server-rendered `.glaze` templates and browser-capable `.ember` components compiled to WebAssembly. One `kiln` binary checks, builds, runs, tests, formats and serves it.

For a coding agent: run `kiln docs --llm` for the guide that matches the installed kiln, or start `kiln mcp` (Model Context Protocol) to check code, read the project graph and run tests with the compiler itself. `kiln check --json` gives diagnostics with exact fixes, and `kiln explain CODE` explains one.

## Guides

- [Kiln for coding agents](https://github.com/IZ737/kiln/blob/main/docs/guides/agents.md): the loop, a minimal app, the language, modules, glazes, data, auth, Wares, tests and common mistakes
- [Your first Kiln site](https://github.com/IZ737/kiln/blob/main/docs/guides/first-site.md): from install to a tested multi-folder site with accounts and a Ware
- [Formatting, live reload and agents](https://github.com/IZ737/kiln/blob/main/docs/guides/tooling.md): `kiln fmt`, `kiln dev` and `kiln mcp`
